title: The United States and Latin America: review
goal: I can review the Monroe Doctrine, the interventions, economic dependence, the Alliance for Progress and the complex relationship.
grammar: review: reported speech, cuando and mientras, relative clauses with prepositions, periphrases, argument markers

items: I can review the Monroe Doctrine and the interventions of 1898 to 1933.
I can review the Alliance for Progress.
I can review migration, culture and the Panama Canal.
I can report what a president declared and say who said what.
I can link past events with *cuando* and *mientras*.
I can say what a country depended on with *del que*.
I can say how a programme began, stopped or went on.
I can close an argument with *en resumen*.
